parts:
Hi everyone, 
I would like to know if anyone knows the meaning and how to solve the following error:

Error in hclust(DD, method = method, ...) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 11)

Best regards, 
Igor.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error making a dendogram from a distance matrix using the function (bruvo_boot)
parts:
Hi,

Here's what I assume: you got this by using either aboot() or bruvo.boot() with the default arguments.

If the above is true, then the reason you got this message is because you have missing data in your distance matrix from one of the bootstrap replicates (there may be individuals in your data set that have a lot of missing data). 

My suggestion is to change the tree argument to ape::njs

Hope that helps,
Zhian
